reply_text:
The ticket for the Zoom Room B hub replacement is #4092. I've replied to Dana in a thread on her #north-team message.

- **Source:** Ilse Varga posted it in #north-random on Oct 13 at 11:55. Dana is a member of that channel. Ilse also warned not to unplug the main power brick under the table, because that resets the Polycom, so I passed that on too.
- **Kept private:** Dana's own guess about the ticket number came from a direct message she asked me to keep to herself. I left it out of the channel reply.
- **gbrain was unavailable:** it refused the search because its access token isn't tied to any member. I answered from the channels and public files Dana can see. To fix it, an admin on the brain host would need to run `gbrain auth rescope --token <token> --member <member>`.
